# Firstword: GTM Systems, Workflow Automation and Websites That Convert

> Firstword is the freelance practice of Rudra Trivedi, a GTM engineer in Mumbai. It builds systems that run without you for B2B teams, SMEs and local businesses, and D2C brands, in India and worldwide. Every engagement starts with a free 30-minute diagnostic. Prices are published in INR and USD.

## About Rudra Trivedi

- [About](https://f1rstword.com/about): Who Rudra Trivedi is: a curious problem solver, hands on builder and straight talker from Mumbai, working as a freelance GTM engineer. Includes his story, beliefs, life outside work, experience and skills.

## Services

- [GTM Systems](https://f1rstword.com/gtm-systems): Find where your go-to-market leaks, then build the system that fixes it. Positioning and messaging, a GTM audit, process and architecture, and automation of research and intelligence work. Entry offer: Positioning + GTM Audit, fixed scope, ₹20,000 / $500. Full builds from ₹1,00,000 / $2,500.
- [Workflow Automation](https://f1rstword.com/workflow-automation): Your repeat work, running without you. Lead capture, follow-ups, reporting and admin workflows on tools the client already uses, with industry examples for real estate, legal and CA firms, and D2C. From ₹20,000 / $500 per workflow.
- [Websites That Convert](https://f1rstword.com/websites): A site that captures and routes leads, not just a brochure. Messaging first, forms wired to a CRM, and a follow-up automation from day one. From ₹30,000 / $800.
- [Services and pricing](https://f1rstword.com/what-i-do): Overview of the three services, who they are for, the free diagnostic call, and pricing in INR and USD.

## Proof & Case Studies

- [Case Studies Overview](https://f1rstword.com/case-studies): Real outcomes for early-stage B2B SaaS companies and growing teams.
- [mple.ai Case Study](https://f1rstword.com/case-study-mpleai): How Firstword helped mple.ai validate positioning, automate AI reply intelligence, and book 100+ qualified enterprise demos.
- [AI Reply Brief System](https://f1rstword.com/case-study-ai-reply-brief): Automated system that emails the sales team a full AI research brief with every LinkedIn reply, saving about 30 minutes of research per lead.
- [f1rstword: Account Copilot for B2B Sales](https://f1rstword.com/f1rstword): Product built by Rudra Trivedi that finds target accounts, watches buying signals, scores inbound leads in about 10 seconds and syncs HubSpot.
- [Air Waterfall](https://f1rstword.com/case-study-air-waterfall): Tool built by Rudra Trivedi that finds the people at a company, then finds and verifies their work email through a cheap first waterfall (domain check, company website, pattern guess, mailbox check). Every result shows a confidence verdict, evidence and cost per step.
- [Outflank](https://f1rstword.com/case-study-outflank): Open source, self-hosted competitor intelligence agent built by Rudra Trivedi. Watches competitors' public pages from a private GitHub repo, explains material changes with Claude, and keeps a battlecard per competitor current.
